places-recodo-de-los-chaparros-ii-abrigo.story: From Albalate del Arzobispo it runs 73 km to Albalate del Arzobispo; allow about 1 h 16 of riding. On the way it passes Covacho Ahumado, Abrigo de la Higuera del Barranco de Ester and back through Covacho Ahumado. The highest point is about 1,100 m. The line favours views over speed.
